'''Logan Stahley''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 7th at [[August 2001 Billings tournament (25 August)]] on 25 August 2001 with [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Drop and Drain with Emergency Deployment]], according to Travis Rumans's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2903">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-28-leaving-billings-8-25-01d2903/ leaving-billings-8-25-01], DeckTech (Travis "Com Igar" Rumans, 28 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-28-leaving-billings-8-25-01d2903/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
